title: IT Infrastructure Procurement 2026
description: Procurement of servers, networking equipment, and managed IT services for Data Center upgrade.

requirements.title: Minimum Annual Turnover
requirements.description: Bidder must have minimum annual turnover of ₹10 Crore in any of the last 3 financial years.

requirements.title: Net Worth Certificate
requirements.description: Positive net worth as per latest audited financial statements.

requirements.title: Years of Experience
requirements.description: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure deployment.

requirements.title: Government Project Experience
requirements.description: Must have completed at least 2 government/PSU IT projects.

requirements.title: ISO 9001:2015 Certification
requirements.description: Valid ISO 9001:2015 quality management certification required.

requirements.title: ISO 27001 Certification
requirements.description: Valid ISO 27001 information security management certification.

requirements.title: Technical Specifications Compliance
requirements.description: Servers must meet minimum spec: 64-core, 256GB RAM, 10TB SSD storage.

requirements.title: Warranty Period
requirements.description: Minimum 3-year onsite comprehensive warranty on all hardware.

requirements.title: GeM Registration
requirements.description: Must be registered on Government e-Marketplace portal.

title: Cybersecurity Services Procurement 2026
description: Procurement of endpoint security, SIEM solutions, and cybersecurity consulting services.

requirements.title: Minimum Annual Turnover
requirements.description: Minimum turnover of ₹5 Crore in last financial year.

requirements.title: Cybersecurity Experience
requirements.description: Minimum 3 years experience in cybersecurity services.

requirements.title: CERT-In Empanelment
requirements.description: Must be CERT-In empanelled organization for security audit.
